Enabled.Name: Show damage type trails
Enabled.Hint: Draw a particle trail on 3D dice rolled for damage or healing, matching the damage type.

Intensity.Name: Trail intensity
Intensity.Hint: How many particles the trails use. Lower it if rolls stutter on this computer.

Afterglow.Name: Keep glowing after landing
Afterglow.Hint: Dice keep a faint aura and a few particles while they lie on the table, as if still charged.
